semantics.origin_rule: Input policy is evaluated at the origin context before downstream composition.

remote_input_scopes.all: All explicitly allowed remote input surfaces.

semantics.identity_rule: Origin identity is explicit and cannot be reconstructed from payload claims alone.
semantics.payload_rule: Payload cannot self-declare broader input scope.
semantics.trace_rule: Accepted data retains origin identity and applied scope provenance.
semantics.separation_rule: Input origin scope is separate from output authorization/schema resolution.

invariants.rule: DWH local/remote, origin, schema, external identity, access path and transport-security semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.
